name: peeragent
description: Delegate arbitrary task work from Codex to a peer local coding agent (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Z.AI GLM 5.2) through skills or the bundled local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate work to a peer coding agent
interface.longDescription: Peeragent wraps local coding agent CLIs so any host (Claude Code, Codex) can hand a focused task to a peer agent (Claude, Codex, Gemini through Antigravity, or Z.AI GLM 5.2 through Pi).
defaultPrompt: Delegate this task to a peer agent.
